gloss: in a meeting; during a meeting

definitions.gloss: in a meeting; during a meeting
definitions.explanation: Indicates that someone is currently attending a meeting and is unavailable. Commonly seen on signs and used as a status indicator.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}は{会議中|かいぎちゅう}です。
examples.english: The department head is in a meeting.

examples.japanese: {会議中|かいぎちゅう}は{携帯|けいたい}をマナーモードにしてください。
examples.english: Please put your phone on silent mode during the meeting.

examples.japanese: ドアに「{会議中|かいぎちゅう}」の{札|ふだ}がかかっていたので、{入|はい}らなかった。
examples.english: There was an "In Meeting" sign on the door, so I didn't go in.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {会議|かいぎ} (meeting) + {中|ちゅう} (during). The suffix 〜{中|ちゅう} can be attached to many activity nouns to mean "in the middle of" (e.g., {食事中|しょくじちゅう}, {授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}).

Often displayed on door signs or as a status message in business settings. In modern contexts, also used as an online status indicator.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会議中|かいぎちゅう}の{電話|でんわ} (a phone call during a meeting)
- ただいま{会議中|かいぎちゅう}です (currently in a meeting — polite)
